hooks.name: remind-grounding-on-skeleton-edit
hooks.description: After the citation skeleton changes, steer the agent back to spans, abstention, and the gold suite.

action.prompt: skeleton.py changed. Follow .kiro/steering/no-invention.md. Answers quote a source span or say not found. A number from one clause must not support a different subject. Do not invent dollar amounts, percents, dates, or ids. Run python3 evals/run_evals.py and python3 -m pytest. Keep cited, not-found, reject, and accept cases green.
